This '''sergeant''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] stationed at [[Haven Base]] on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]].<ref name="MC 61" />

==Biography==
He was one of the Rebels who worked on modifying the captured [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] of the [[Flying Bantha Squadron]]. The sergeant explained the modifications to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] shortly before his mission to attack [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mils Giel|Giel]]'s [[secret armada]].<ref name="MC 61" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sergeant's uniform strongly resembles early [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel trooper]] concept art for {{Film|IV}} by [[Ralph McQuarrie]].<ref name="SW Art RM">''[[Star Wars Art: Ralph McQuarrie]]''</ref> A similar trooper can be seen in the [[1986]] comic [[Droids (1986) 6|''Droids'' 6]] which features an alternate retelling of the film.<ref name="Droids 6">[[Droids (1986) 6|''Droids'' (1986) 6]]</ref>
